items.title: Walmart opens an MCP gateway to AI shopping agents as Amazon blocks them
items.note: Agent Gateway lets approved agents buy via Walmart and Sam's Club over MCP; Amazon is blocking Meta's Muse agent

items.title: Microsoft starts treating deployed AI agents as insider threats
items.note: new Microsoft 365 E7 and Project Perception tools score every agent's risk and can contain or shut it down, now covering 60 agent types

items.title: OpenAI brings its frontier models to Google Cloud
items.note: GPT-6 Astra, Sol and Luna land in Google's Model Garden within weeks, widening where a rival lab's models can run

items.title: Home affordability lags historical norms in 98% of US counties
